name: drawdown_adaptive_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, large institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms create directional micro-trends detectable by Supertrend(2-min ATR) — when NIFTY is in a bullish Supertrend AND trading above session VWAP, buy-side program flow is dominant at multiple timescales and 30-60 second continuation is high-probability. The drawdown-adaptive layer tracks NIFTY's intraday session high-water mark: beyond 0.4% session drawdown, CE entries are suppressed (market is in a distribution/sell-program regime where Supertrend bullish whipsaws are common), and beyond 0.7% session drawdown all entries halt (index is in stress/liquidation mode where the signal degrades entirely). This regime filter mirrors the original's anti-martingale logic — during index drawdown, the order book skews bearish and a Supertrend long is fighting institutional flow.
core_signal_oneliner: 2-minute Supertrend direction aligned with VWAP position for 2+ consecutive bars, with session drawdown below 0.4% gating CE entries and 0.7% halting all entries
